scope: independent root audit of the compulsory interval divisor in the Item410 scalar carriers, both phase carriers, provenance relative to Item200, corrected radical target, height screen, dependencies, and deterministic replay

checks.root_repairs: Canonicalized all paths and status, added strict frozen replay, and made explicit why the extended opposite-phase rational sums have no terms beyond the ordinary coefficient range modulo ell.

mathematical_audit.R_pair_divisibility: For ell in (4m,6m), Lucas reduces every surviving binomial(6m,r) term to r<=6m-ell or r=ell+s. In each parity, the half-integral upper argument of binomial(x,4m) has a representative in {0,...,4m-1}, so every E_m and O_m summand vanishes modulo ell. Denominators are ell-units.
mathematical_audit.matching_phase: Taking n_ell=ell-6m-1<0 places every U/V upper binomial argument for the matching phase in the same root interval, so ell divides both matching-phase scalars termwise.
mathematical_audit.opposite_phase: After shifting by 2ell, the opposite phase equals the two terminal coefficients at n'=3ell-6m-1. Extra extended-sum terms have upper indices in {0,...,4m-1} and vanish. Frobenius writes the relevant polynomial as (1-z^ell)^2R with deg R=ell-(6m-ell)-3; the requested two degrees are exactly the two-point gap between the middle and last support bands.
mathematical_audit.provenance: Q_m is Item200's already known j=0 Cartier strip times only the optional boundary prime 4m+1. Item414 newly transports that compulsory support into W_m and both J phases; it is not a new divisor reservoir.
mathematical_audit.normalization_correction: Whenever the carriers are nonzero, their full radicals have at least theta(6m)-theta(4m)=2m+o(m). Thus Item410's proposed full-radical zero-rate target is impossible; only the >6m radical controls actual compatible H-collision primes.
mathematical_audit.capacity: Removing Q_m improves the elementary Item410 height constant by 1/3, but the resulting 2.2209868... remains noncompetitive with the inherited large-component ceiling. No mass or ceiling is booked.
